Subject: Follow-up & clarifying token volumes for Private deployment

Hi Samir / Anika —

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier. Quick recap and a couple clarifying questions so we can land accurate pricing for Private (VPC) and the initial SOW:

Summary from our side:
- Opal is targeting a secure private deployment for clinical-document summarization and chat, initially for 3 environments (dev / staging / prod).
- Expected steady-state throughput: ~25M tokens/month for summarization pipelines, plus bursty chat traffic (~5M tokens/month peak).
- Security: SOC 2+HIPAA controls required; KMS integration needed.

Questions we need to finalize pricing (please reply inline):
1) Can you confirm whether the 25M tokens/month is per-team or company-wide? If per-team, how many teams will be onboarded in Q1?
2) For environment separation, will QA/staging need the same GPU sizing as prod or is a smaller capacity acceptable?
3) Any hard budget range for infra + license for the first 12 months? A rough band (e.g., $150k–$350k) is fine for alignment.

Attachments: Redwood-Private-pricing-v2.pdf (pricing bands + support tiers) and a draft SOW that assumes 3 envs.

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm the three points above by EOD Fri (20th)
- If numbers line up, we circulate a short SOW for procurement review and a final pricing anchor.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if it's easier.

—Laura

Laura — thanks for the recap and attachments. Quick answers below inline.

On Wed, Nov 18, 2026 at 3:12 PM Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com> wrote:
> 1) Can you confirm whether the 25M tokens/month is per-team or company-wide?

This is company-wide for the first rollout. We expect 2 additional teams in Q2 which could add another ~15M tokens/month.

> 2) For environment separation, will QA/staging need the same GPU sizing as prod or is a smaller capacity acceptable?

Staging can be smaller (we're comfortable with 1/3 of prod capacity). Prod needs the full footprint.

> 3) Any hard budget range for infra + license for the first 12 months?

Procurement prefers to see a total TCO estimate. Our internal target is in the $200k–$300k range for year one (including licensing + dedicated support). If you can show a $/1M tokens anchor it helps.

We will loop in procurement formally if you can provide a SOW + pricing anchor.

—Samir

Thanks Samir — noted on company-wide baseline and staging capacity.

Samir / Anika: sharing a quick pricing anchor to make procurement math easier:
- Year-one estimate (anchor): $240,000 total (includes private license + 24/7 enterprise support + 3 envs with prod capacity for inference).
- Unitized anchor: ~$15 / 1M tokens (this is license+infra blended; exact unit price varies by quantization and reserved capacity).
- If you plan to add teams in Q2 (additional ~15M tokens), incremental unit cost drops by ~18% due to reserved GPU commits.

Attached is a short worksheet (in the PDF) showing sensitivity across token bands and support tiers.

Next steps from our side:
- Laura to produce a one-page SOW with option A (3 envs, prod capacity) and option B (3 envs, reduced staging).
- If procurement confirms the $200k–$300k band, we will prepare a DocuSign-ready SOW and pricing appendix.
